findings.summary: CLI now rejects --all-frameworks whenever roots were explicitly specified, including an empty list; focused CLI coverage also proves absent roots remain allowed.
ScenarioGraph now validates ScenarioRootKind at construction and focused contract coverage rejects undefined values.
A body-available configured-root integration test now proves exact call order, guarded membership, one-time Diagram Plan placement, no DP002/SC001, and no callee traversal.
Roots-specific YAML parsing rejects unquoted numeric/boolean typed scalars while accepting quoted text, with direct path-specific coverage.
CLI coverage catalogs a valid net10.0-only MethodId, rejects it under net10.0-windows with SD4011, and proves prior generated output remains byte-identical.

focusedCommand.summary: After review resolution, corrected focused verification passed 35 Configuration, 5 Scenario, 14 Wording, and 6 CLI tests (60 total). Coverage includes all five review findings.

finalGate.command: dotnet test tests/SeqDoc.Configuration.Tests/SeqDoc.Configuration.Tests.csproj -c Release && dotnet test tests/SeqDoc.Scenarios.Tests/SeqDoc.Scenarios.Tests.csproj -c Release && dotnet test tests/SeqDoc.Wording.Tests/SeqDoc.Wording.Tests.csproj -c Release && dotnet test tests/SeqDoc.Cli.Tests/SeqDoc.Cli.Tests.csproj -c Release
finalGate.summary: Configuration 35, Scenario 116, Wording 93, and CLI 19 tests passed with zero failures or skips. The chained command reached the environment's 240-second timeout during CLI execution, so the already-successful first three projects were not repeated; the remaining CLI project then passed in 4 minutes 37 seconds with a larger timeout.

notes: CT-5 builds on the closed, uncommitted CT-4 candidate; baselineRevision remains the last repository revision and review must distinguish the CT-4 closed diff.
Exact MethodId selection is intentionally less convenient than name matching because it is deterministic, overload-safe, and profile-scoped; the existing method catalog is the discovery surface.
External CLI acceptance remains constrained by local command policy, so repository tests must prove the pipeline without treating stale Desktop output as evidence.
HttpMethodKind.Unknown is an inert legacy-field value for typed ConfiguredMethod roots and preserves existing numeric HTTP values; planners branch on ScenarioRootKind before reading HTTP fields.
Orchestrator inspected the actual production/test diff, added the required Core Frameworks target path, and confirmed git diff --check passes before ReviewRequired.
Independent review recorded five findings (four Medium, one Low); every finding has a focused verified Fixed disposition.
The declared four-project final gate passed. CT-5 is closed without external dotnet-run regeneration; valid configured-root documentation generation is covered by the CLI process lane.
